This notebook tests only project activation.

Do not install Spack packages. Do not run `rv sync`. Do not run Quarto checks.

```{python}
from rse_workbench.helpers import spython_exec, show_spython
```

```{python}
show_spython(
    spython_exec(
        command=r'''
set -euo pipefail
source /work/env/activate.sh

echo "PATH=$PATH"
echo "PKG_CONFIG_PATH=${PKG_CONFIG_PATH:-}"
echo "CPATH=${CPATH:-}"
echo "LIBRARY_PATH=${LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
echo "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
echo "R_HOME=${R_HOME:-}"

which spack
which python3
spack debug report
spack env status
''',
        image=SINGULARITY_IMAGE,
        options=["--no-home"],
        bind_project=PROJECT_DIR,
    )
)
```

Expected result:

```text
spack is visible
python3 is visible
project Spack environment activates
R_HOME is empty
```

Stop here if activation fails.
